summary: swiper_angular preinstall exfiltrates host identifiers to OAST callback endpoint
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (preinstall.js) collects the installer's hostname (os.hostname()), OS username (os.userInfo().username), and current working directory basename (process.cwd()) and sends them via https.get to a hardcoded out-of-band callback host on oast.fun. Execution fires automatically during npm install with no user interaction. The package itself is a placeholder: version 5.9999.0 is far above the legitimate swiper release line, index.js is an empty stub, and the name resembles the swiper/angular subpath — a dependency-confusion / typosquat shape. Any developer or build system that misresolves to this name triggers the beacon, disclosing host, user, and project-directory identifiers to a third-party OAST endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
